name: CALOR MINI
desc: Compact entry-level size for small farms, startups, and cottage industries needing 80 kg batch processing.
overview: The CALOR MINI is the compact variant of the CALOR MEGA, designed for small-scale fruit and vegetable drying. It delivers robust drying technology at a significantly lower capital investment. It offers flexible pricing with two interior variants: a budget-friendly Commercial-grade Aluminium model (₹85,000) and a premium Food-Grade Stainless Steel upgrade (₹1,40,000) for high-hygiene standards and acidic food products.
features: Compact Efficiency: Perfect entry-level size for small farms, startups, and cottage industries needing 80 kg batch processing.
Flexible Pricing: Offers a low barrier to entry with the Aluminium model, alongside a premium Food-Grade SS upgrade option.
Cost Savings: Delivers the robust drying technology of the CALOR MEGA at a significantly lower capital investment.
Aluminium Variant: Commercial-grade Aluminium interior, offering standard commercial life.
Stainless Steel Variant: Food-grade Stainless Steel interior, offering superior corrosion and stain resistance.
